content: Look up at the stars and not down at your feet. Try to make sense of what you see, and wonder about what makes the universe exist. Be curious.
author: Stephen Hawking
story:
Preserved as part of Stephen Hawking's enduring intellectual legacy, this reflection addresses the fundamental nature of stars and science. Across his life and work, Stephen Hawking returned repeatedly to the conviction that personal integrity, honest observation, and clarity of purpose are the foundational pillars of a life well-lived.

Contemplating this truth invites us to step back from the frantic rush of daily demands. By examining our assumptions with fresh eyes, we discover the inner grounding necessary to act with wisdom and quiet conviction.
reflectionPrompt: Where in your current routine are you choosing convenient illusion over uncomfortable truth?
